answer: Formally call them out one-on-one because it violates close-rider social norms for anyone to loosen their attention span once the relationship is built. Avoid mentioning it in front of others or through social media, or you could make yourself seem like a big baby. If they apologize, you should accept a single ice breaker like buying them coffee or handing them a gift card without asking for detailed conversation. Trading pleasantries that mention the thing you forgot simply proves you two were never really close enough, and it’s probably best to skip the traditional 3-day rule and just end it when the actual “gift time” comes.
